configurePresets.name: postgresql
configurePresets.description: Default driver. Requires VCPKG_ROOT to point at a bootstrapped vcpkg checkout.

configurePresets.name: mysql
configurePresets.description: Requires VCPKG_ROOT to point at a bootstrapped vcpkg checkout.

configurePresets.name: mssql
configurePresets.description: Uses CMake's FindODBC — the system ODBC driver manager on Windows, unixODBC (unixodbc-dev) on Linux/macOS. Also needs an actual SQL Server ODBC driver installed and registered (e.g. Microsoft's msodbcsql18) — see CMakeLists.txt. Does not need VCPKG_ROOT.

configurePresets.name: sqlite
configurePresets.description: No external dependencies — sqlite3.c is vendored under third_party/sqlite. Does not need VCPKG_ROOT.

configurePresets.name: oracle
configurePresets.description: Not distributed via vcpkg (license). Install the Instant Client Basic + SDK packages and point OCI_ROOT or ORACLE_HOME at the install directory. Does not need VCPKG_ROOT.

configurePresets.name: all
configurePresets.displayName: All drivers (PostgreSQL + Oracle + MySQL + SQLite + MSSQL, one binary)
configurePresets.description: Compiles every driver into one binary, selectable at runtime via QcConnectionParams::driver. Requires VCPKG_ROOT (for PostgreSQL/MySQL), Oracle Instant Client (OCI_ROOT/ORACLE_HOME), and unixODBC + a SQL Server ODBC driver (MSSQL) all installed at once — see the per-driver presets above for each dependency individually.
